stageA.populationAlignment: Strongest direct axes selected before field staging; shared values stay on the first line and subgroup values retain source order.

stageA.structuredSweep: All results tables and usable figures checked for counts, incidence, burden, severity, confidence intervals, recurrence, mechanism/contact, diagnosis/type and location. Illness families were absent in all five papers.
derivedValues: No exposure, rate, burden or days-lost value was back-calculated.
S5005 match exposure of 4455 h is the paper's explicit 1.5 h x 22 players x 135 matches calculation and is retained as printed.
S3944 pooled recurrence 4.4% was not forced onto a phase row because the source has no Total population line.

blankStructuredFamilies.S3075: No published incidence, burden, severity-duration, mechanism/contact split or clean subgroup outcome table; illness families absent.
blankStructuredFamilies.S5005: No compatible tissue family beyond head-injury/concussion diagnosis; position data describe injured players rather than category-aligned event counts; illness families absent.
blankStructuredFamilies.S3944: Ankle/foot, hip/groin and pelvis/sacrum are combined source locations without exact combined schema rows; only Knee is mapped. Median severity is retained in the headline field and not misfiled as structured mean severity; illness families absent.
blankStructuredFamilies.S5158: No anatomical-location data beyond the diagnosis and no clean broad contact/non-contact mapping; median severity is not misfiled as structured mean severity; illness families absent.

studyDetails.title: Characteristics of match-related head injuries in professional women's football: A prospective cohort study.
studyDetails.journal: Journal of Science and Medicine in Sport

participantCharacteristics.observationDuration: 2024 competitive season (March to mid-November; 135 league matches)

definitions.injuryDefinition: all complaints [three nested match-related head-injury/SRC categories using progressively stricter MHCQ symptom and clinical-sign criteria]
definitions.severityDefinition: days from injury occurrence to first full-contact training session or match
definitions.mechanismReporting: video analysts, team physiotherapists, and player MHCQ interview

injuryTissueType.injuryTissueType_injury_diagnosis_diagno:
match-related head injury
suspected sports-related concussion
diagnosed sports-related concussion

caveats: The three rows are nested definitions rather than disjoint cohorts; all use the same direct 4455 match-hours denominator.
The broad match-related head-injury row requires at least one MHCQ symptom and is not equated with diagnosed concussion; the dedicated concussion row begins at Suspected SRC.

Figure 4 was readable and checked: 6 collisions, 4 aerial-duel contacts, 2 non-intentional ball impacts, 1 intentional header and 1 fall-related head impact. The paper does not split these mechanisms across all three category rows.
Median severity remains in the headline median field and is not placed in structured mean-severity fields.

studyDetails.title: Distal-to-proximal progression of apophyseal injuries with age in male youth academy footballers: a two-season prospective cohort study of 16,024 player-seasons.

participantCharacteristics.levelOfPlay: Premier League and Category One academy

definitions.injuryDefinition: time loss [physical complaint preventing full participation for at least 1 day after injury]
definitions.incidenceDefinition: match- and training-related apophyseal injuries per 1000 player-hours
definitions.severityDefinition: days lost per injury event; reported as median (IQR)
definitions.recurrenceDefinition: same injury type and site after return to full participation

injuryTissueType.injuryTissueType_injury_diagnosis_diagno:
apophyseal injury
apophyseal injury
apophyseal injury
apophyseal injury

caveats: The source reports 603 apophyseal injuries overall, but Table 2's phase-aligned incidence/burden frame contains 453 match- and training-related injuries. The phase rows retain only that compatible frame.
Raw phase exposure hours are not printed and were not back-calculated from counts and rates; this Premier League injury-surveillance study remains eligible under the league-database rule.
Table 2 ankle/foot, hip/groin and pelvis/sacrum categories have no exact combined schema rows and were intentionally not forced into narrower locations; Knee is mapped directly.
The pooled 4.4% recurrence rate is not assigned to the first phase row because no Total population row exists.

studyDetails.title: The incidence and burden of concussion in men's and women's English professional football.
studyDetails.studyDesign: retrospective analysis of routinely collected injury-surveillance data

participantCharacteristics.ageCategory:
U15-senior
U15-senior
adult professional
adult professional

definitions.injuryDefinition: time loss [medically diagnosed concussion preventing participation for at least 1 day]
definitions.severityDefinition: days before return to training or match play; reported as median (IQR)

caveats: Raw exposure totals are not printed and were not back-calculated. The FA league/international injury-surveillance database is an eligible reporting channel under the workflow rule.

Women's domestic overall incidence and burden use only 2020/21-2021/22 because corresponding exposure was missing for 2018/19-2019/20; counts and median severity cover all four seasons as the paper reports.
Table 5 position counts exclude unknown positions (1/15/91/48 unknown by cohort); the direct known-position counts are retained without imputation.
The inciting-event categories do not support a clean broad contact/non-contact split, and no anatomical-location table is reported.
